QUALITY.TITLE: Quality you can see
QUALITY.INTRO: Not a marketing claim — verified live, right here on the page.
QUALITY.A11Y_TEXT: Simulate a vision impairment and see for yourself: content stays readable and usable.
QUALITY.A11Y_MOCK_TITLE: Websites that work for your business.
QUALITY.A11Y_INFO_TEXT: Each filter changes colors the way a person with that impairment would perceive them — from red-green and blue-yellow color blindness to severe vision impairment (grayscale). This shows whether content stays distinguishable and usable even without full color perception.
QUALITY.SPEED_TEXT: Not a marketing figure — measured directly in your browser, right now.
QUALITY.SPEED_FOOTNOTE: Measured via your browser's Navigation Timing API, freshly on every visit.
QUALITY.SPEED_INFO_TITLE: Why is this faster than WordPress?
QUALITY.SPEED_INFO_TEXT: WordPress rebuilds every page on every visit: PHP runs, the database gets queried, often dozens of plugins and a theme load — that takes time. This site, by contrast, is pre-compiled: a lean, ready-to-go Angular bundle, no database query, no plugin overhead. The browser only has to display it, not assemble it.
QUALITY.WCAG_TEXT: Keyboard navigation and color contrast — test it yourself, don't just take our word for it.
QUALITY.WCAG_TAB_HINT: Press Tab to move through the fields — focus always stays visible.
QUALITY.WCAG_INFO_TEXT: Press Tab to move through the boxes — the visible focus ring proves the site is usable without a mouse. For color contrast, the site calculates the real contrast ratio of your chosen colors live, using the official WCAG formula, and checks whether it meets the minimum of 4.5:1 for text.
QUALITY.PRIVACY_TEXT: Swiss data protection law (nDPA) and EU GDPR — considered from day one, not bolted on afterwards.
QUALITY.PRIVACY_POINT_1: Server location for the best possible protection — e.g. Switzerland or the EU
QUALITY.PRIVACY_POINT_2: No third-party trackers, no Google Fonts
QUALITY.PRIVACY_POINT_3: Data minimisation from the ground up
QUALITY.PRIVACY_INFO_TITLE: Why does this matter — and for whom?
QUALITY.PRIVACY_INFO_TEXT: GDPR and Swiss nDPA apply based on the destination principle: what matters is where your customers are, not where the server sits. Server location doesn't change which law applies. What it does affect is transferring data abroad: servers in the US are also subject to US laws like the CLOUD Act, which can allow US authorities access, and require extra safeguards (e.g. standard contractual clauses). Servers in Switzerland or the EU avoid that complexity. That's why I choose the location together with you, based on your customer base and your needs. Regardless of location, one rule always applies: your customers and website visitors need to know what happens to their data — clearly, not buried in fine print.
QUALITY.DOMAIN_TEXT: Your domain is often the first impression — more important than most people think.
QUALITY.DOMAIN_POINT_4: A proper email address instead of @gmail.com looks more professional
QUALITY.DOMAIN_FOOTNOTE: I'll advise you on the choice before you register anything.
